name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing & Sales Operations Manager | AI-First Automation & Trade Channel Experience
summary: Channel experience two ways: built AI-driven marketing automation specifically for home-services trade businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC-type) as a GoHighLevel affiliate at Solenzo, and managed a network of independent reseller partners at Birdeye, channel-model sales, not direct, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals. Not manufacturers'-rep or distributor experience specifically, worth saying plainly, but real fluency in how trade businesses operate and how partner-channel relationships work. On the AI side: builds and runs AI agent workflows daily as the operating model, not a tool bolted onto old habits, 20+ automated workflows spanning lead capture, qualification, appointment booking, and re-engagement, all self-built and continuously improved.

Built segmented cold-email outreach engines (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews campaigns) plus an automated prospect 'audit' workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring a business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates hyper-personalized outreach.

Design self-improving evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize performance.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.
